title: Acute shortness of breath
priority: Among the top ED reasons for visit in NHAMCS fact sheets.

layer0.label: History
layer0.detail: Known heart failure, lung disease, VTE risk factors.

layer0.label: Exam
layer0.detail: Pain on inspiration and one-sided absent breath sounds point to pneumothorax; fever, localized pleuritic pain and dullness point to pneumonia.

gate.label: Respiratory failure or instability
gate.detail: Resuscitate first; the elimination route assumes a stabilized patient.

gate.label: Stable
gate.detail: Work through heart, lung and clot causes in parallel.

gate_note: Gate wording is a structural convention, not taken from a source.

hypotheses.name: Pneumothorax
hypotheses.clue: Pain on inspiration, absent breath sounds

ptx.text: Dyspnea, pain on inspiration, one-sided absent breath sounds.

pna.text: Fever, localized pleuritic pain, dullness, egophony.

acs.text: Shortness of breath counts as an anginal equivalent.
Ischemic change escalates; one normal ECG does not rule ACS out.

steps.title: Chest radiograph
steps.description: Finds lung causes and changes PE probability.

ptx.text: Normal film with distress, pleuritic pain and hypoxia excludes pneumothorax.

pna.text: Infiltrate confirms; a normal film makes pneumonia unlikely.

pe.text: A normal film in a hypoxic, distressed patient raises PE probability.

ahf.text: With echocardiography and judgment, helps in the natriuretic peptide grey zone.

steps.title: Natriuretic peptide
steps.timing: Single measurement in new suspected heart failure

ahf.text: BNP below 100 ng/L or NT-proBNP below 300 ng/L rules out heart failure.

steps.title: PE route
steps.timing: In parallel if PE is open
steps.description: Wells or PERC, then D-dimer or CTPA (see chest pain).

pe.text: Low pre-test probability with negative D-dimer, or negative CTPA.

steps.title: Echocardiography
steps.timing: If heart failure is not ruled out

eliminate_when.text: BNP below 100 ng/L or NT-proBNP below 300 ng/L in new suspected acute heart failure.

do_not_rely.text: The rule-out threshold in older patients, obesity or prior heart failure: false negatives of 1 in 10 to 1 in 5.
NT-proBNP rule-out above age 75: negative predictive value fell to about 88% in one cohort.

eliminate_when.text: Low pre-test probability and negative D-dimer.
Low-risk class with non-ischemic ECG and negative serial troponin.
Normal chest radiograph with distress, pleuritic pain and hypoxia.
Normal chest radiograph makes it unlikely.

copd.no_rule_note: No route sourced; GOLD and GINA guidance would be the next sources.

gaps.title: Grey zone
gaps.text: Between rule-out and rule-in natriuretic peptide thresholds, about half of older patients have heart failure; echo and judgment decide.

gaps.title: Unsourced gate
gaps.text: The stabilization gate and the COPD/asthma branch need sourcing.
